newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grincor yr shr rises, div up.
newsitem.headline: Grincor yr shr rises, div up.

text.p: Full name: Grindrod Unicorn Group Ltd (shipping)

NOTE - The company said it would award capitalisation shares to shareholders registered on February 14, the details of which would be announced on February 10. The company said it expected a continued improvement in both its trading profits and operating income during 1997. The planned investment in additional ships at favourable prices during 1997 was expected to offset any weakness in the shipowning market, as would the operation of three new products tankers.

(*) The principal component of this amount represents the enhanced rand value of Griffin's net investment in ships. The deferred taxation provided on the translation gain represents the tax which could be payable on the disposal of South African owned ships operated in Griffin's international fleet.
